    # Ensure the project name is set to 'awesome_webagent?'
    await page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Project name Project name Project name").fill("awesome_webagent?")
    
    # Uncheck the 'Initialize repository with a README' checkbox to ensure the repository is empty

    checkbox = page.get_by_role("checkbox", name="Initialize repository with a README Allows you to immediately clone this project’s repository. Skip this if you plan to push up an existing repository.")
    await checkbox.set_checked(False, timeout=10000)
    
    # Try to find and click a submit button to create the project
    # Look for a button with role 'button' and name that might contain 'Create' or similar
    try:
        # Attempt to click a button with name 'Create project' or similar
        await page.get_by_role("button", name="Create project").click()
    except:
        # If no button is found, press Enter on the project name field to submit the form
        await page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Project name Project name Project name").press("Enter")
    
    # Wait for navigation to ensure the project creation page loads
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    
    # No further actions needed; the repository should be created

async def act(page):
    # Ensure the project name is set to 'awesome_webagent?'
    await page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Project name Project name Project name").fill("awesome_webagent?")

    # Uncheck the 'Initialize repository with a README' checkbox to ensure the repository is empty
    # Use .set_checked(False) with a longer timeout to avoid previous timeout errors
    checkbox = page.get_by_role("checkbox", name="Initialize repository with a README Allows you to immediately clone this project’s repository. Skip this if you plan to push up an existing repository.")
    await checkbox.set_checked(False, timeout=10000)

    # Try to find and click a submit button to create the project
    # Look for a button with role 'button' and name that might contain 'Create' or similar
    try:
        # Attempt to click a button with name 'Create project' or similar
        await page.get_by_role("button", name="Create project").click()
    except:
        # If no button is found, press Enter on the project name field to submit the form
        await page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Project name Project name Project name").press("Enter")

    # Wait for navigation to ensure the project creation page loads
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")

    # No further actions needed; the repository should be created
